title: AuroraJobs
summary: A full stack job board with Ruby on Rails: search, alerts, company portal and CMS. A complete product, built as the sole developer after initial mentoring from the CTO.
problem: Generalist job boards mix everything with everything. AuroraJobs explored a more focused space, with careful search and alerts that actually helped.
audience: People looking for a job and companies posting openings.
role: Full Stack Developer with full ownership of the cycle: from idea to production, working close to product decisions.
responsibilities: Full product development: models, search, alerts, internal dashboard, company portal and CMS.
Mentoring two junior developers and running SCRUM.
Deployment and running it in production (Kubernetes).
Product decisions alongside the team: what to build and what to drop.
decisions: Monolithic Rails with Stimulus: development speed over sophisticated architecture.
Search as the product's centerpiece, not an added filter.
Email alerts as the main channel to bring users back.
outcomes: A complete product running in production for years.
The experience that consolidated my full stack years and how I work with product.
